python3 -c 'import csv,json,statistics,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path("systems/dual-rtx3090")
reports={}
for name in ("torch-gpu0","torch-gpu1","vllm"):
    report=json.loads((root/"comparison"/(name+".json")).read_text())
    before=Path(report["baseline"]); after=Path(report["unlocked"])
    a=json.loads((before/"result.json").read_text()); b=json.loads((after/"result.json").read_text())
    assert {k:v for k,v in a.items() if k!="results"}=={k:v for k,v in b.items() if k!="results"}
    assert (before/"scripts.sha256").read_bytes()==(after/"scripts.sha256").read_bytes()
    assert all(r["output_hashes_match"] for r in report["results"])
    arms={}
    for arm,path in (("stock",before),("unlocked",after)):
        data=json.loads((path/"result.json").read_text())
        if "torch" in name: assert all(r["finite"] for r in data["results"])
        with (path/"gpu.csv").open() as f:
            reader=csv.DictReader(f,skipinitialspace=True)
            rows=[{k.strip():v.strip() for k,v in r.items()} for r in reader]
        number=lambda row,key:float(row[key].split()[0])
        limits=sorted(set(number(r,"power.limit [W]") for r in rows))
        assert limits==[350.0],(name,arm,limits)
        active=[r for r in rows if number(r,"utilization.gpu [%]")>=90]
        arms[arm]={"rows":len(rows),"power_limits_w":limits,"max_temperature_c":max(number(r,"temperature.gpu") for r in rows),"high_utilization_samples":len(active),"high_utilization_median_power_w":statistics.median(number(r,"power.draw [W]") for r in active) if active else None,"high_utilization_median_sm_mhz":statistics.median(number(r,"clocks.current.sm [MHz]") for r in active) if active else None}
    reports[name]={"same_runtime_metadata":True,"same_all_script_hashes":True,"all_output_hashes_match":True,"telemetry":arms}
logs=subprocess.check_output(["journalctl","-k","-b","--no-pager"],text=True)
xids=[line for line in logs.splitlines() if "NVRM" in line and "Xid" in line]
report={"checks":reports,"post_benchmark_xid_messages":xids,"telemetry_note":"Both cards are in each CSV; aggregates pool card samples. Utilization >=90% excludes most idle authentication time but includes initialization. Short sequential runs have different initial thermal conditions."}
(root/"comparison/validation.json").write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
assert not xids
